# Smuggler

Universal SQLite sync engine. Content-hashed delta sync across SQLite, D1, Turso, rqlite, Datasette, StarbaseDB, and SQLite Cloud. LAN broadcast. S3 relay. Agent-friendly JSON output and typed exit codes.

Repo: https://github.com/rafters-studio/smugglr
Site: https://smugglr.dev

## Install

Native CLI: `cargo install smugglr`
Rust crate: `cargo add smugglr-core`
npm (WASM): `npm install smugglr`

## Global flags

- `--config <PATH>`: path to config.toml (default: `./config.toml`)
- `--verbose`, `-v`: print detailed sync operations to stderr
- `--output <FORMAT>`: `text` or `json` (default: `text`)

## Commands

### Sync
- `smugglr push [--table NAME] [--dry-run]`: push local rows to remote
- `smugglr pull [--table NAME] [--dry-run]`: pull remote rows to local
- `smugglr sync [--table NAME] [--dry-run]`: bidirectional, conflict strategy from config
- `smugglr diff [--table NAME]`: read-only comparison

### Relay (S3-compatible)
- `smugglr stash [--table NAME] [--dry-run]`: upload to relay
- `smugglr retrieve [--table NAME] [--dry-run]`: download from relay

### Snapshots (point-in-time)
- `smugglr snapshot [--dry-run]`: create snapshot on relay
- `smugglr snapshots`: list snapshots
- `smugglr restore <TIMESTAMP> [--dry-run]`: restore from snapshot

### Daemon
- `smugglr watch [--interval SECS] [--dry-run]`: background sync loop

### Network
- `smugglr broadcast [--port PORT] [--interval SECS] [--once] [--dry-run]`: encrypted UDP LAN sync

### Info
- `smugglr status`: config, source, target, relay reachability

## Exit codes

- 0: success
- 1: general error
- 2: config error (fix config, do not retry)
- 3: network / transient (retry with backoff)
- 4: conflict (re-read state, then retry)
- 5: not found (fix the name)
- 6: plugin error (depends on adapter)

## Config (config.toml)

Minimum:

```toml
[source]
path = "./local.db"

[target]
type = "d1"
database = "my-database"
account_id = "..."
api_token = "..."
```

Sections: `[source]`, `[target]`, `[sync]` (conflict strategy, table filters, batch size), `[watch]` (interval, enabled tables), `[stash]` (S3 endpoint, bucket, region, credentials), `[broadcast]` (encryption key, port, interface), `[plugins.http-sql.profiles.<name>]` (per-backend profiles).

Target types: `d1`, `turso`, `rqlite`, `local`, `datasette`, `starbasedb`, `sqlite-cloud`.

Conflict strategies (in `[sync]`): `local_wins`, `remote_wins`, `newer_wins`, `uuid_v7_wins`.

## JSON output

Every command emits a consistent structure when `--output json` is set:

```json
{
  "command": "push",
  "status": "ok",
  "dry_run": false,
  "tables": [
    { "name": "users", "rows_pushed": 3 }
  ]
}
```

Error:

```json
{
  "command": "push",
  "status": "error",
  "error": "network timeout connecting to d1://my-database"
}
```

Watch emits JSONL (one object per sync cycle).

## Common workflows

Local dev to Cloudflare D1:
```
smugglr push --dry-run
smugglr push
```

Pull production data for local debugging:
```
smugglr pull
```

Continuous background sync:
```
smugglr watch --interval 60
```

LAN sync between dev machines:
```
smugglr broadcast --interval 10
```

Cross-network via S3 relay:
```
# machine A
smugglr stash
# machine B
smugglr retrieve
```

Disaster recovery:
```
smugglr snapshot
# later
smugglr snapshots
smugglr restore <TIMESTAMP>
```
